title: ExperimentRun v1alpha1
description: The manifest of one run of one experiment against one delivered release: which experiment and which frozen record the run answers, the commit it executed, the environment, the release, the runtime image, the model, the caller profile, the fault, the result state, the intended evidence level, the evidence files by digest, the cleanup state, and what the run does not establish. It is a repository document, not a Kubernetes resource: no custom resource definition, controller, or cluster reads one. It references every input and every evidence file by an immutable identity and carries none of their content. The result state, the evidence level, and a claim's status are three separate things: this document has one member for the first, one for the second, and none for the third. This schema is structural only: the rules that compare two members, or a member with a registered profile, are stated in docs/contracts/experiment-run.md and are not enforced here.

apiVersion.description: Contract group and maturity version. Together with kind it names this schema; a breaking change requires a new value here, never a redefinition of this one.

limitations.description: What bounds the run. Every run has at least one limitation: one run, on one environment, at one time.

doesNotEstablish.description: What a reader must not conclude from the run. At least one statement is required.

identifier.description: An experiment or run identifier: 1 to 63 characters, a letter or digit first, then letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens. It is the pattern the reliability caller record accepts for the same two identifiers, so one run can carry one identifier in both documents.

dnsLabel.description: A DNS-safe stable identifier, lowercase, the same pattern and bound as the WorkloadContract's, the EnvironmentBinding's, and the RenderedWorkloadRelease's identifiers.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, with no algorithm prefix. Uppercase hexadecimal, a sha256: prefix, and any other length are refused, so one digest has exactly one spelling.

gitRevision.description: A full Git commit identifier, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters. A branch name, a tag name, and an abbreviated identifier are refused: each can come to name another commit.

utcInstant.description: A UTC instant, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ with an optional fraction of one to six digits. It is the form the reliability caller record writes. An offset other than Z is refused, so two instants compare as text of the same form. The schema checks the form only: 2026-13-40T25:61:61Z matches the pattern and is not an instant.

repositoryPath.description: A path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes. A leading slash, a drive letter, a backslash, and a parent segment are refused, so the document cannot carry a personal filesystem path.

evidencePath.description: The path of one evidence file, relative to the directory that holds this manifest, lowercase, with forward slashes. Each segment starts and ends with a letter or digit, so a leading slash, a drive letter, a backslash, and a parent segment are refused: the path cannot leave the run's own directory.

digestPinnedImageReference.description: An OCI image reference pinned by digest, exactly as the WorkloadContract accepts one. A tag alone is a movable label and is not accepted.

text.description: One statement in prose. It is the only free text this document holds. It is bounded, and it is not a place for a prompt, a completion, a response body, a credential, or a host path.

metadata.description: Which run of which experiment this is, which frozen record it answers, and which commit it executed.

experimentId.description: The experiment the run belongs to.

runId.description: The identifier of this run. A run keeps its identifier for as long as its evidence exists; a second attempt is a second run with another identifier.

executingRevision.description: The commit the run executed: the commit whose tree held the procedures, tools, and desired state the run used.

finishedAt.description: When the run ended, whatever its result state.

spec.description: The frozen experiment record the run answers, by path, revision number, and content digest. The record's content is not copied here.

freezeRecord.description: The repository path of the freeze record.

freezeRevision.description: The revision number of the freeze record. Revisions are numbered from 1.

freezeContentSha256.description: The content digest of the freeze record: the SHA-256 of its bytes with every CRLF replaced by LF, as the freeze registry defines it.

environment.description: Where the run executed. The evidence of a run is bounded to this environment.

provider.description: The cluster provider the run observed. The schema holds no provider vocabulary: a provider is named when a run executes on it, and naming one here does not raise an evidence level.

kubernetesVersion.description: The Kubernetes server version the run observed, as the server reports it.

nodeCount.description: The number of nodes the run observed.

environmentBindingReference.description: The EnvironmentBinding of the release, by identity and digest, as the RenderedWorkloadRelease records it. Its content is not copied here.

environment.description: The binding's spec.environment, from the same controlled vocabulary as the EnvironmentBinding's.

sha256.description: The digest the release records for the binding.

release.description: The delivered release the run exercised, by the identities its RenderedWorkloadRelease records and by the desired-state commit.

contractSha256.description: The release's source.contract.sha256: the digest of the WorkloadContract.

helmValuesSha256.description: The release's output.helmValues.sha256: the digest of the generated values.

desiredStateRevision.description: The Git commit that held the desired state the delivery controller was to apply. It is what the run intended. What the controller reported is evidence, in an evidence file.

runtime.description: The serving runtime of the release.

model.description: The model of the release, by the identities the WorkloadContract pins.

identifier.description: The model identifier the API serves the model under.

revision.description: The revision of the model's source repository: 40 to 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, as the WorkloadContract pins it.

sha256.description: The digest of the model artifact.

callerProfile.description: The caller profile the run sent. A run either names one registered profile revision or states that none applies, with the reason. It is never left out.

applies.description: True when the run sent a caller profile.

profileId.description: The profile's identifier, such as RP-1.

contentSha256.description: The content digest of the profile file: the SHA-256 of its bytes with every CRLF replaced by LF.

concurrency.description: The number of concurrent callers the run used.

fault.description: The fault of the run. A run either states that its frozen record registers no fault, with the reason, or names the registered fault and states whether the run injected it. An injected fault names its target and its time. A registered fault that was not injected states why.

registered.description: True when the frozen record registers a fault for this run.

type.description: The registered fault type, such as delete-runtime-pod. The schema holds no fault vocabulary: the frozen record does.

injected.description: True when the run injected the registered fault.

target.description: The recorded identity of what the fault acted on, such as pod/name: lowercase segments separated by slashes.

injectedAt.description: When the run injected the fault.

reason.description: Why no fault is registered, or why the registered fault was not injected.

result.description: The result state of the run. It is one of five run states and it is not an evidence level: FAILED and INCONCLUSIVE are states of a run, and C0 to C4 are levels of evidence. A run that is INCONCLUSIVE, REFUSED, or ABORTED states why.

state.description: PASSED: every frozen criterion held. FAILED: a frozen criterion did not hold. INCONCLUSIVE: the evidence does not decide a criterion. REFUSED: a precondition failed and the run did not start its procedure. ABORTED: the run started and an abort condition stopped it.

reason.description: Why the run has this state.

evidenceLevel.description: The evidence level the frozen record intends for the run, under InferOps Evidence Levels. It is separate from the result state: a FAILED run at C2 is runtime evidence of a failure. The run does not assign a level to itself: the level of an evidence record is stated in the claim and evidence register.

intended.description: C0 Static, C1 Substituted Execution, C2 Runtime, C3 Representative, C4 Operational. The meanings are those of docs/testing/evidence-levels.md and this schema changes none.

evidence.description: The evidence files of the run, each by role, path, and digest. The files are referenced and never carried. A run that was refused before it wrote a file names none.

evidenceFile.description: One evidence file. The manifest is not one of them: a file cannot hold its own digest.

role.description: What the file is evidence of. The role caller names the caller's own record of its requests. The schema holds no other role vocabulary.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

cleanup.description: The state of the cleanup after the run. A cleanup that is not verified states why.

state.description: verified: the cleanup ran and the run observed its check. incomplete: the cleanup did not finish, or the run did not observe its check. not-required: the run created nothing to remove.

reason.description: Why the cleanup is incomplete or not required.

left.description: What the cleanup left in place, one statement for each item.
